risks.risk: Wrong camera model (not actually D810) or different lens than claimed (24-70mm).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model name/label (or menu “About” screen) plus a close-up photo of the lens model text/engraving (e.g., 24-70mm) and mount markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR with an unreadable/uncertain lens model (worst-case match to the lowest comparable lens-only listing).

risks.risk: Shutter count is higher than claimed (or shutter replacement history).
risks.proof: Screenshot/export of shutter count from-camera or via a reliable shutter-count app, showing the number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not meeting the “under 5,000” condition (worst-case: treat as higher shutter wear).

risks.risk: Lens may have haze/fungus/scratches not visible in one photo.
risks.proof: Video/clip of the lens glass against a bright light (flashlight) from multiple angles, plus a close-up of front and rear elements.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens may have issues (worst-case: treat as not guaranteed clean).

risks.risk: Battery/charger may be non-original or missing.
risks.proof: Photos of the exact battery and charger with visible branding/labels and included items.
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery/charger not guaranteed original (worst-case: treat as incomplete/unknown).

risks.risk: Camera may have faults (focus issues, shutter/IBIS problems, sensor dust) not shown.
risks.proof: Short test video + sample photos (sharpness at multiple focal lengths, autofocus lock, and a blank white/sky shot to check sensor spots).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown working condition (worst-case: assume basic functionality only).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera model (D810) from the body label or the in-menu “About” screen.
Close-up photo of the lens engraving showing the exact lens model (confirm it is 24-70mm) and mount compatibility.
Close-up front and rear lens element photos under strong light (to confirm no fungus/haze/scratches).
Photos of the included battery and charger showing branding/labels.
A quick test: 3 sample photos (wide/mid/tele) and one blank/white frame to check sensor dust.
response.reason: The photo confirms a Nikon DSLR with a lens, but the exact D810 model and the 24-70mm lens model, shutter count, and lens condition cannot be verified from the single image. Without those, a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct item.
